edges.reason: mint reads and increments _tokenId before minting
admint reads and increments _tokenId before minting
addPVP increments _charId as the new PVP key
mint loads pvps[charId] to check price and availability
admint loads pvps[charId] to check availability and uri
addPVP writes the new struct into pvps[_charId]
mint updates pvps[charId].currentUnits only after the safe-mint external callback
_safeMint in mint performs an external call to onERC721Received before state finalization
mint uses msg.sender as NFT recipient and payer
withdrawAll performs payable(owner()).send(amount)
_authorizeUpgrade onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender
pause onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender
unpause onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender
addPVP onlyOwner restricts the caller to the contract owner
admint onlyOwner restricts privileged minting to the contract owner
mint reaches the _beforeTokenTransfer hook through _safeMint/_mint
admint reaches the _beforeTokenTransfer hook through _safeMint/_mint
_burn triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI
admint's _safeMint calls onERC721Received on the recipient contract
_uri parameter is stored in the new Pvp struct in addPVP
_price parameter is stored in the new Pvp struct in addPVP
_units parameter is stored in the new Pvp struct in addPVP
charId parameter selects pvps[charId] in mint
charId parameter selects pvps[charId] in admint
recipient parameter is the mint target in admint
from parameter is used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
to parameter is used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
tokenId parameter is used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
newPVP local struct is assembled and written in addPVP
pvp local struct is read from storage in mint
pvp local struct is read from storage in admint
amount local stores address(this).balance in withdrawAll

_price is only consumed by addPVP when building the Pvp struct
_units is only consumed by addPVP when building the Pvp struct

from is only used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
to is only used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
tokenId is only used by the _beforeTokenTransfer override
newPVP is a temporary struct created and stored by addPVP
pvp is a temporary storage copy read by mint
pvp is a temporary storage copy read by admint
